# Enable your first category {#recipe-first-category}

**Tool:** kailash (the distribution) · **Section:** Getting started ·
**Level:** easy · **Time:** ~10 minutes · **Layer/Category:**
CLASSIC · **Tags:** getting-started, taxonomy, category

## Problem

You have a profile applied; now you want to extend beyond the
default tool set — say the ATTACK A-2 category for LLM
prompt-injection work — while keeping the declarative build intact.

## Solution

<!-- PENDING: recipe not yet worked against the 2026.01 pin. The
profile/category selection UI will be verified first (see the
first-profile recipe and the guide's install chapter); this recipe
lands its worked commands then — no invented flags before that. -->

Expected output shape:

```
category: <id>
tools enabled: <n>
```

## Discussion

Categories are the taxonomy's working unit (four layers, 32
categories). The declarative build means adding a category is a
configuration act with a rebuild, not a package-manager side-effect.
